title: Rider Fee Schedule Clause: Damage Fee Charged on Approval at a Receipt-Based Level
content:
**Clause.** The fee charged when a receipt-based Cleaning and Damage Fees damage report is approved is based on the repair amount on file and is held to a ceiling of the level's receipt fee cap, rounded half up to the cent: it is the repair amount on file, never more than the level's receipt fee cap. The fee charged on approval is the amount booked as the fee charge.

| Damage level held | Receipt fee cap |
|---|---|
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | $350.00 |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | $750.00 |

The four cleaning levels are flat levels and show a receipt fee cap of $0.00; this clause concerns the two damage levels.

## Elements

- **Repair amount on file.** The repair receipt or repair estimate amount the assessment holds.
- **Ceiling.** The receipt fee cap of the damage level the assessment holds at approval.
- **Rounding.** Half up to the cent, once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical repair amounts)

| Damage level held | Repair amount on file | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | $486.25 | $486.25 |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | $820.00 | $750.00 |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | $212.60 | $212.60 |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | $412.40 | $350.00 |
